guide.overview:
Park View City Lahore is the Vision Group's gated housing society off Multan Road at Shahpur Kanjra, between Multan Road, Thokar Niaz Baig and the River Ravi. Its 153 ft Main Boulevard and the Broadway commercial run north through the society to the Overseas Block.

Blocks

The society is made of named blocks: Overseas in the north; Diamond, Platinum, Orchard and Imperial along the main boulevard; Tulip, Tulip Overseas and Tulip Extension in the middle; Crystal, Silver and Pearl to the south-west; and Executive, Rose, Topaz, Jade, Jasmine and Sapphire on the eastern side towards Park View Villas.

Plot sizes

Residential plots range from 3 and 5 marla to 1 and 2 kanal, with commercial plots on the Broadway and the boulevards.

Buying in Park View City

Check a plot's block, approval and dues with the society office before you buy. Browse the houses and plots for sale and rent in each block below, and call or WhatsApp the dealer directly.
